The plate is about 390 px across in the image. If it is a standard dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, that gives about 15 px per cm.

The food looks like two strips of candied or glazed bacon, stacked or overlapping. Each strip is about 330 px long, which is roughly 22 cm. That seems long for bacon, so the plate may be smaller, closer to a 20 cm side plate. At 20 cm, the strips are about 17 cm long, which is more plausible for bacon.

Each strip is about 1.5 to 2 cm wide. Cooked bacon weighs about 8 g per slice. These strips look thick and glazed, so I estimate about 12 g each, or about 24 g for two.

Candied bacon is roughly 450 kcal per 100 g.
